title: Quantitative Near-Kerr Evolution and Generic C2 Future Inextendibility
main_claim: For each fixed rotating subextremal Kerr bridge (0<a<M), there is a p_10-neighborhood U_eps of the bridge data, with arbitrary symbol-bounded asymptotically flat tails allowed, in which the smooth vacuum data whose full MGHD has a C^2 future extension form a meagre set (local C^2 strong cosmic censorship).

issues.location: Sec. 4-6 (Prop. st:hhv, co2:stationary-energy, far:closure) and appendices far-energy/far-sources
issues.description: As an internal step, the exterior analysis amounts to global nonlinear stability of the full-subextremal Kerr exterior with integrable time-weighted decay (A_S>1, A=1.36). It is built on HHV2025 linear input together with a new conic gauge calibration that enforces the trapping subprincipal threshold. The argument is extremely compressed: absorptions are asserted through long chains of choices rather than displayed. I could not verify it line by line. I found no specific failing step, so this is a coverage caveat, not a demonstrated gap.
issues.evidence: Spot checks all passed. The weight margins hold: p_P-A=1.62-1.36=0.26; p_P+0.1A=1.756<2; 2A_H=2-2eta>1.36; p_0,p_H<1, which gives finite initial energy for r^{-1} tails. The gauge algebra checks: E=d_k^{-1}AP_k, C=AR_k gives d_kE+CQ_k=A, and the only constraint, on the screen quotient, is satisfied because that quotient's transport is a rotation. The exterior-to-interior entry uses only cell-summability via <t>^{A_S}, A_S>1. The full nonlinear-closure bookkeeping (far:total-closure) could not be independently reproduced.

coverage: Read closely: the intro and Sec. 2 (closed tests, regular-exit covering, finite-observation criterion — the logic is sound); the Sec. 8 classification of where geodesics first leave the comparison region and the corner-ratio/branch-seed argument (sound: the reciprocal boost keeps the tangent unit timelike, the corner intervals become disjoint once 4delta_c<2log(1+sigma), and the homotopy keeps the arc inside P_d); and the Sec. 9 packet amplitude, deep comparison and tidal-observation exponents. Those exponents check: A_T~e^{-2(kappa+zeta)T}; the (P7) error ~e^{-5kappa T/2+delta T} sits below A_T when zeta<kappa/4; the quadratic term needs (P_*-2)zeta<kappa; the energy rate is 2kappa over s-length T/2; the leading tidal term is (1/2)A_T lambda^2 sigma_T at the H=U/Y_T scale; and the p_m cost ~A_T lambda^{m+1}poly(T) goes to 0 for small zeta. Also checked the Kerr Hamilton-Jacobi null equation (in:HJ), kappa_-, the profile-depth inequality (in:profile-depth), and the conic gauge calibration algebra (st:conic-gauge), plus the trapping uncertainty argument at a structural level. Skimmed: the compact high and higher-order estimates and the far closure. Not checked: the far-energy/far-sources appendices in detail, the constraint appendix, Sec. 3 geometry, or the internals of the return-ray beam and exterior transfer.
sibling_notes: The sibling C1 paper (Generic-C1-..., same family 264) reported no_gap_found and relies heavily on Foundation companions. This C2 paper is self-contained apart from cited external results (HHV2025, Dyatlov2016, Hintz2017, DafermosLuk2017). Its intro cites KerrCOne/KerrWeakConnection only for the weaker-regularity refinements, so there is no circular dependence.
